description: WebMCP is one tool contract over two transports. The seven tools registered through document.modelContext MUST have the same names, the same argument names and byte-identical results as the local stdio MCP server for the same input and Bundle; registration is feature-detected, so a page with no document.modelContext still works. The two write tools are local-only on the browser transport: they return the Proposal payload and perform no network write, and the auto publish mode is unavailable there. Without this vector AGSC-09-16 is the only normative rule in the specification with no executable test.
reason: Withdrawn for 1.1.0 (2026-10-29). It pinned the seven tool names of the tool server and of WebMCP, and AGSC-09-13 and AGSC-09-16 now name ten (`brief`, `explain` and `check` are added), so the case would fail on every conforming 1.1 engine. Superseded by cli-0026: the same comparison of the two transports over the ten names.
